correctness.rationale: Every triangle on the extension is either old, a unary Katětov constraint, or a new-new-old triangle. A valid finite diagram embeds, and homogeneity aligns its named base with the given A. An isometry of such diagrams extends to an automorphism over A, so each diagram contributes exactly one complete ordered pair type. Unary admissibility is no 1 and 3 together for base distance 1, unrestricted for distance 2, and at most one 1 for distance 3. The positive unary vectors are nonalgebraic: one can make arbitrarily many copies with all mutual distances 2. For s=1 the local forbidden entries are (1,3),(3,1), for s=2 there are none, and for s=3 only (1,1) is forbidden. This gives the product row for base distance 2 and the stated intersection correction -4·2^n+1 for base distance 1. For base distance 3 at s=1, both vectors either avoid 1 (4^n), have just one occurrence between them (2n·4^(n-1)), have one each at a common coordinate (n·4^(n-1)), or have them at distinct coordinates (n(n-1)·4^(n-2)). At s=3 the common coordinate case is forbidden; each separated 1 leaves two choices for the other entry at that coordinate. At s=2 the count is the square of the unary count. These recover all coefficients, the all-n linear identity and the leading vectors (2,4,3), (0,1,0) after scaling by 9^n, and (1,4,4) after scaling by n²·4^(n-2). Normalizing by the row sum gives the stated laws and by the squared unary count gives the mean multiplicities. The n=1 row (7,9,8) is independent of the vacuous base parameter. Separate direct checks at n=1,2 agreed; the frozen script was inspected, not replayed.
residual_risks: No material proof gap found. The n=1,2 check is corroboration only; the proof does not assume any finite range exhausts n.

value.rationale: The complete family is an exact benchmark for joint type counts in the unrestricted generic metric. It separates concentration at distance 2 in the unconditioned base-distance-2 regime from two different mixed laws for the other base distances. Those mixed laws even share the same limiting mean number of available distances, so the mean and one-point counts alone do not reveal the distinction. The nine-channel comparison has use beyond restating the standard metric extension criterion or recounting the already overlapping entries.
residual_risks: The distribution is over logical types, not over sampled points. The formulas are not claimed for nonequilateral bases or for three new points.
